Cross-Domain Misconfiguration

http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/Challenges/?name=Score+Board

Web browser data loading may be possible, due to a Cross Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) misconfiguration on the web server.

Suggested fix

Low Verified Security

X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing

http://127.0.0.1:3000/socket.io/?EIO=4&transport=polling&t=Q4X50Nn
Element: x-content-type-options
Header: x-content-type-options

The Anti-MIME-Sniffing header X-Content-Type-Options was not set to 'nosniff'. This allows older versions of Internet Explorer and Chrome to perform MIME-sniffing on the response body, potentially causing the response body to be interpreted and displayed as a content type other than the declared content type. Current (early 2014) and legacy versions of Firefox will use the declared content type (if one is set), rather than performing MIME-sniffing.

Suggested fix
Ensure that the application/web server sets the Content-Type header appropriately, and that it sets the X-Content-Type-Options header to 'nosniff' for all web pages. If possible, ensure that the end user uses a standards-compliant and modern web browser that does not perform MIME-sniffing at all, or that can be directed by the web application/web server to not perform MIME-sniffing.
Evidence & verification

Independent GET: x-content-type-options absent.

ZAP rule 10021, confidence Medium

Independent GET: x-content-type-options absent.

Sources: OWASP ZAP passive baseline · ID 5cb914d6fd6e

Scope & limitations

  • URL-only black-box snapshot, not a comprehensive penetration test or WCAG certification.
  • No account creation, credential attempts, payment, upload, mutation method or destructive action is submitted. Server-side login/checkout coverage is intentionally limited.
  • Only same-origin resources are loaded. Third-party scripts/fonts/images are blocked; rendering and performance may differ from a normal browser.
  • Laboratory LCP/CLS and TBT are measured. Field Core Web Vitals percentiles and INP are not invented.
  • Some local AI tasks were unavailable or failed; no external/closed-model fallback was used.
  • AI cases & safe form validation: partial. Executed 10/12 client-side cases. No credentials or state-changing submissions; server-side login/checkout behavior remains untested. Some cases used deterministic fallback, not AI generation.
  • Internal links & browser errors: partial. Checked 7/9 internal links; SPA fragments require browser coverage. Replayed 2 AI-selected known-page flows through read-only navigation.
  • Lighthouse performance audit: partial. Mobile laboratory Lighthouse. LCP/CLS/TBT/FCP measured; field INP not fabricated.
  • AI desktop & mobile visual review: skipped. Local vision review completed 0/4 screenshot tasks; visual findings stay Possible.
  • AI security finding triage: skipped. Local triage completed 0/2 bounded batches. Verified facts cannot be suppressed by AI alone.
  • Derived AI-stage coverage was rebuilt from the original recorded task statuses; no scan, finding, measurement or verification result was invented.
